confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain; hostel, hotel, and drink prices are less certain because La Ceiba is a secondary city with thin public price data. The FX value 0.6955 comes from search-result summary text attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview (4pm, 15 October 2026). I did not read that page directly, so verify it against RBA table F11 before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No sourced price survey was used. Estimates are based on general knowledge of mid-sized Central American Caribbean-coast port and tourism towns with budget-oriented pricing. Beer is the base for drink pricing: cocktail and wine were set at about 2x and 2.4x beer respectively, because direct knowledge of local bar and wine prices is weak.
